message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a central caricature of a man seated in a large, tufted maroon armchair. He wears a dark grey suit jacket over a light-colored button-down shirt and glasses. He holds a dark cigar to his lips with his right hand, and a long plume of cream-colored smoke rises from it, curving behind the large white text "TEMPO" at the top.

In the foreground, a green-topped table is visible. On it, a white outline of Southeast Asia is drawn. A hand of five playing cards—a royal flush in hearts (10, J, Q, K, A)—is fanned out over the map.

The background is a dark olive green. The top section contains a red rectangular banner. White text on the cover includes "TEMPO," "TENTAKEL JUDI KAMBOJA," and smaller paragraphs in Indonesian. At the bottom left, there is a white box containing a barcode, a QR code, the date "7-13 APRIL 2024," price "RP 60.000," and other publishing information. Additional headlines appear at the top: "Beban Besar Bank BUMN H.74" and "Perlawanan Aktivis Lingkungan terhadap PSN H.82."
